meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 它会查看 GitHub 仓库中所有打开的 issue 和 PR，逐个分析并归类（如 bug、功能请求等），为每个条目生成一份带证据链接（permalink）的报告，保存到 /tmp 下的时间戳文件夹。它只做只读分析，绝不会在 GitHub 上评论、合并、关闭或打标签。
howto.when: 当你说出“triage”“triage issues”“triage PRs”等关键词，或要求对 GitHub 仓库做 triage 分析时触发。

say.text: 帮我 triage 一下仓库里的 issues
say.note: 为每个打开的 issue 生成分析报告。
逐个分析所有打开的 PR 并写出报告。
对整个仓库的 issues 和 PRs 做只读分析。

howto.what_en: Scans all open issues and PRs in a GitHub repo, classifies each one, and writes a permalink-backed report per item to /tmp/{timestamp}/. Read-only: never comments, merges, closes, or labels on GitHub.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', or 'github triage'.

say_en.text: Please triage the issues in this repo
say_en.note: Generates an analysis report for each open issue.
Analyzes every open PR and writes a report.
Read-only triage of all issues and PRs in the repo.
